pages.text: Dates ripen among the palm fronds: right-click the ripe leaves. A honey cake is two wheat, honey and dates, and it heals. The sistrum of Hathor: gold, two nuggets and a stick.
The eye of Horus is needed against Set, the knot of Isis wins a priestess's heart. They are found in the chests of temples and tombs, and the priest of Anubis sells the eye.
